assumptions.choice: Daily volume is cumulative 5-minute-bar volume for the current trading day; the 20-day average uses the preceding 20 completed trading days.
assumptions.reason: The feed is intraday-only, so final current-day volume is unavailable at entry time.

assumptions.choice: Feed timestamps are interpreted directly as EST/EDT market-local times.
assumptions.reason: No timezone-conversion information is provided by the fixed feed setup.

assumptions.choice: Entries are allowed strictly after 10:00 AM through 2:30 PM inclusive.
assumptions.reason: This applies the stated exclusion of the 9:30–10:00 AM first 30 minutes together with the stated 9:30 AM–2:30 PM entry window.

assumptions.choice: Stop-loss and take-profit orders are placed after the market entry fills, using its actual executed price.
assumptions.reason: A market order's exact entry price is unavailable before execution; therefore same-bar protective coverage cannot be guaranteed in this environment.
